subject.title: [Bug]: xAI OAuth failures silently reroute the catalog to the paid api.x.ai API-key provider

question: When xAI OAuth credential resolution throws while an API key is available, should OpenClaw retain API-key fallback with a visible redacted warning, or mark the OAuth route configured-unavailable and require explicit user recovery?
rationale: Both outcomes change what existing OAuth-plus-API-key users experience during transient or migration-related credential failures, and repository policy treats provider fallback and auth routing as upgrade-sensitive product behavior.

options.title: Warn, then preserve fallback
options.body: Keep the established OAuth-first/API-key-fallback behavior, but emit a typed redacted warning naming the failed credential owner and the API-key route selected.

options.title: Fail the OAuth route closed
options.body: Do not publish the API-key catalog after OAuth-resolution errors, so users must repair or migrate the OAuth credential before requests proceed.

recommendation.title: Warn, then preserve fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the established OAuth-first/API-key-fallback behavior, but emit a typed redacted warning naming the failed credential owner and the API-key route selected.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent detailed xAI OAuth routing context, although a current-main history owner should confirm the final provider contract.
